slug: 2026-02-06 ADETIC, ANSICE, and TECHSO-GROUP Join Forces to Protect Chad's Digital Infrastructure

facts.fact: ANSICE, with its Deputy General Manager present, signed a tripartite agreement on 5 February 2026 to audit the security of the National Data Center.
